name: ST NUCLEO-WL55JC1 (Nucleo-64, 868/915 MHz)
description: LoRa / (G)FSK sub-GHz dual-core (Cortex-M4 + M0+) Nucleo-64 with SMA antenna, ST-LINK and Arduino headers; the JC1 is the 868/915 MHz (EU/US/AU) version.
notes: Order code matters: NUCLEO-WL55JC1 is tuned for about 865-930 MHz (EU868/US915); NUCLEO-WL55JC2 (about $42.5) is the low-band 433/470-510 MHz board and is not interchangeable.
The LoRa radio is the MCU's built-in sub-GHz transceiver (no extra radio chip). RF switch and TCXO use a few pins, so about 40 GPIO are free (estimate).
The product page and id cover both JC1 and JC2; data here is for the JC1.
